spec.query:
SELECT elapsed("b_run", 1m) - 1 AS "downtime_minutes"
FROM (
    SELECT last("b_run") AS "b_run"
    FROM "dongtien_realtime"
    WHERE $timeFilter AND "machine" = 'PM6'
    GROUP BY time(1m) fill(previous)
)
WHERE "b_run" = 2

SELECT cumulative_sum("ton") AS "Tổng sản lượng"
FROM (
    SELECT
        integral("ton_per_min", 1m) AS "ton"
    FROM (
        SELECT
(
    last("speed_machine") *
    4.6 *
    mean("basic_weight") *
    0.97
) / 1000000 AS ton_per_min
FROM "dongtien_realtime"
WHERE
    "machine"='PM6'
    AND $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m)
    fill(none)
    )
    GROUP BY time(1m)
    fill(0)
)

SELECT cumulative_sum("ton") AS "Tổng sản lượng"
FROM (
    SELECT
        integral("ton_per_min", 1m) AS "ton"
    FROM (
        SELECT
(
    mean("nominal_speed") *
    4.6 *
    mean("nominal_bw")
) / 1000000 AS ton_per_min
FROM "paper_daily_nominal"
WHERE
    "machine"='PM6'
    AND $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m)
    fill(previous)
    )
    GROUP BY time(1m)
    fill(0)
)

SELECT last("A") AS "Availability"
FROM (
    SELECT mean("b_status") * 100 AS "A"
    FROM "dongtien_realtime"
    WHERE $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m)
    fill(none)
)
GROUP BY time(1h)
fill(none)

SELECT count("diff") AS "Số lần dừng máy"
FROM (
    SELECT difference(last("b_run")) AS "diff"
    FROM "dongtien_realtime"
    WHERE $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m), "device"::tag
)
WHERE "diff" < 0
SELECT last("b_run") FROM "dongtien_realtime" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "device"::tag
SELECT mean("basic_weight") FROM "dongtien_realtime" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "shift"::tag, "device"::tag fill(null)
SELECT mean("basic_weight") FROM "dongtien_realtime" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "shift"::tag, "device"::tag fill(null)

SELECT mean("speed_actual") FROM "dongtien_realtime" WHERE ("machine"::tag = 'PM6' AND "device"::tag = 'Tốc độ đầu cuộn') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "shift"::tag, "device"::tag fill(null)

SELECT mean("speed_actual") FROM "dongtien_realtime" WHERE ("machine"::tag = 'PM6' AND "device"::tag = 'Tốc độ đầu cuộn') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "shift"::tag, "device"::tag fill(null)
